gen-gf-sniglet-gf-zen-maru-gothic: Zen Maru Gothic moves through a line like following a single thread, never snagging on a closed-up bowl. And Sniglet above it stops its terminals short of curling, a level, quiet display voice over that plain sans.
gen-gf-sniglet-ibm-plex-sans: IBM Plex Sans keeps a wide channel open into every bowl, which gives it a technical but friendly feel. Sniglet's heading letters hold a gentle, level line thickness, while IBM Plex Sans runs lower in contrast still.
gen-gf-sniglet-zilla-slab: Round-ended and bold, Sniglet looks like a pen drawn with a technical steadiness, no weight accents anywhere. Sniglet draws attention with that level display voice; Zilla Slab does its work with sturdy, broad-opening curves.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-fs-amulya: Snowburst One cuts its letters like a stencil sheet, with wide bridges between them and tall lowercase. Amulya follows with generous gaps in its curves, so a longer passage moves along easily in a modern sans.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-fs-chillax: Chillax reads casual and relaxed, its sans line looping like spaghetti, with pen-lifted curves that leave loops unfinished. Longer text drifts along loosely, a loose counterpoint to Snowburst One's stencil bridges and tall lowercase.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-fs-plein: Stencil bridges, tall lowercase, plenty of attitude. Plein gives each round letter a clear channel in, so Snowburst One gets a reliable, clean sans-serif partner for its expressive cut.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-fs-roundo: Snowburst One is a stencil sheet with wide bridges between its letters, and its lowercase stands tall. Roundo answers with geometric, steel-rod lines and unclogged small counters, a plain sans of moderate height.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-fs-spline-sans: Spline Sans reads approachably, with wide gaps between curve ends and stems at identical stroke weight. If Snowburst One were made small, its stencil bridges and tall lowercase would crowd, so let it stay big and keep that marker-like plainness below.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-fs-synonym: Expressive from the first stencil bridge, Snowburst One stands tall in the lowercase, while Synonym lays down a plain stripe of constant ink. Their strongest quality is that clean split between a showy cut and a plain sans.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-aclonica: Snowburst One is a stencil sheet with wide bridges and tall lowercase, built for bold display work. And Aclonica stretches out wide beneath it, its soft shifts in thickness felt more than seen, so give it a bit more size than usual.
